name: American Express Plenti® Card
notes: American Express states that the Plenti loyalty program ended on July 10, 2018, with all Plenti program accounts closed and unredeemed points expired. This is not a credit-card withdrawal or conversion notice and does not support the previously recorded February 16, 2018 card withdrawal date. The old card URL returns a generic shell and the checked servicing URL returns 404; card availability, withdrawal date and successor remain unknown. Historical fees and rewards remain unverified. Card art provenance (checked 2026-10-21, secondary source, lower confidence): no usable official issuer image was found, so this is a local upload under the repo's option-C convention (image.provenance.source "other"; the sha256 is of the downloaded file). The source page is recorded here because secondary_sources is reserved for discontinued cards: https://www.uscreditcardguide.com/amex-plenti-credit-card/; https://www.uscreditcardguide.com/wp-content/uploads/Plenti-AMEX.png. Match: Amex EveryDay-style Plenti Credit Card from American Express face on the card's review page. The artwork remains the copyright of the issuer; it is for identification only and is not evidence of lifecycle or financial fields.
